name: tKOIAgent
description: Transcriptomics Knowledge Graph-Driven Omics Integration Agent for Claude Desktop
long_description: tKOIAgent is a specialized multi-tool analysis agent that combines R-based transcriptomics analysis with Neo4j biological knowledge graph querying. It enables Claude to analyze gene expression data, perform network propagation using tKOI, and contextualize results using the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph. The agent supports complete workflows from raw differential expression data to interpretable biological insights, including pathway enrichment, disease associations, and publication-quality visualizations.

prompts.name: Transcriptomics Analysis Workflow
prompts.description: Complete workflow for analyzing differential gene expression data using tKOI network propagation.
prompts.text: I have a differential expression dataset. Please help me: 1) Clean and standardize the data, 2) Run tKOI network analysis, 3) Export results, and 4) Interpret the biological findings using the SPOKE knowledge graph.

prompts.name: Gene Pathway Enrichment
prompts.description: Query the SPOKE knowledge graph to find pathways associated with a set of genes.
prompts.text: Find all pathways associated with my list of differentially expressed genes and identify which pathways are shared by multiple genes.

prompts.name: Gene-Disease Association Analysis
prompts.description: Explore disease associations for genes of interest using the biomedical knowledge graph.
prompts.text: Query the SPOKE knowledge graph to find disease associations for my significant genes and summarize the key disease connections.

prompts.name: Knowledge Graph Exploration
prompts.description: Explore the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph schema and relationships.
prompts.text: Show me the SPOKE knowledge graph schema including all node types and relationship types, then help me write Cypher queries to explore gene-pathway-disease connections.

prompts.name: Data Cleaning for tKOI
prompts.description: Prepare and clean transcriptomics data for tKOI analysis.
prompts.text: Help me clean my differential expression data: convert gene IDs to Ensembl format, normalize column names to gene_name/logfc/pvalue/fdr, and export both full and significant-only datasets.

prompts.name: tKOI Network Analysis
prompts.description: Run tKOI network propagation analysis on prepared expression data.
prompts.text: Run tKOI analysis on my cleaned expression data with default parameters, save the results, and export the network summary statistics to Excel files.

prompts.name: Biological Interpretation Report
prompts.description: Generate a comprehensive biological interpretation of tKOI results.
prompts.text: Based on my tKOI results and knowledge graph queries, generate a comprehensive biological interpretation report including key genes, pathways, diseases, and the overall biological story.
